name: 適用範囲を説明する言語と利用場所の設定
prompt:
Make a precise palette-only edit of Image 1 and return one 390×284 panel. Image 1 is the exact Japanese component crop and controls every position, dimension, word, line break, font size, margin, and crop boundary. Keep it pixel-faithful except for the card surfaces and chevron color. Image 2 controls the approved Lighthouse palette only.

Apply these changes only: change the two rounded setting-card fills from light gray to pure white (#FFFFFF); add a delicate 1px neutral border (#D8DDE1); change both small chevrons to slate (#526173). Leave the white page canvas white. Preserve all six Japanese strings exactly as visible. Preserve the first heading at x16 y20, first card at x16 y62 size 358×70, second heading at x16 y173, and second card at x16 y214 size 358×70, flush to the bottom of the 390×284 crop. Do not move either heading/card, shrink the lower card, add bottom whitespace, change spacing, scale, or reflow any content. Maintain the exact typography and card corner shape from Image 1.

No background tint, shadow, green accent, gradient, extra padding, phone frame, icons, labels, or decoration. The finished panel must align to the exact Image 1 geometry at native size.
reviewNotes: Actual-size visual review against the exact 390x284 Japanese crop. White card surfaces and fine neutral borders; geometry and copy align within 1-2 px. Candidate review only; native editability, interactions and owner approval are not established.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
